purpose: Teach: ユリ/蟻/死神/邦楽/半径/オゾン/ダシ/漢文

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家の庭にユリ咲いてんな
lines.en: Hey Riku — you've got lilies blooming in your garden.
lines.style: Casual observation, slightly playful. Light, conversational tone. Like she's noticed something small and is mentioning it without fanfare.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お弁当に蟻が入ってたな、桜
lines.en: You had an ant in your bento the other day, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry, almost deadpan. Matching her energy but flipping the script. Small smile underneath — he's been waiting to land this one.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、死神のキャラ好きだろ?
lines.en: Wait — you really like those shinigami characters, don't you?
lines.style: Sudden realization, almost accusatory in tone but warm underneath. Like she's caught him in something and finds it endearing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽の授業で邦楽やったろ?桜
lines.en: You studied Japanese music in class, right? Sakura?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, turning her curiosity back on her. Steady pace. Not defensive, just mirroring — testing if she notices.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、数学で半径の計算苦手だろ?
lines.en: Riku — you're not great at radius problems in math, are you?
lines.style: Teasing but not unkind. Light rhythm, like she's listing things she's noticed about him. Quick delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、理科でオゾン層の単元やったろ?桜
lines.en: You covered the ozone layer in science class, didn't you? Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet persistence. Like he's asking something he already knows the answer to. Gentle curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、給食のダシ巻き卵好きだろ?
lines.en: You like the dashi egg roll from the lunch menu, right?
lines.style: Lighter now. Smaller observation. Noticing the details. Warm rhythm — he's aware of what she likes too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、国語で漢文の単元やったろ?桜
lines.en: You did the classical Chinese poetry unit in Japanese class, didn't you? Sakura?
lines.style: Closes gently. Quieter delivery. Like he's bringing the back-and-forth to a soft landing. Still holding her gaze.
